The balance therefore favours Existing, with substantial residual weight on Hypothesized given the mixed/weak human association data.

justification: No paper reports two or more independent probands/families with NSF variants causing epilepsy, so Established is excluded. The strongest human genetic hint is the long-read sequencing DEE study (PMID 42045022), which identified a candidate SNV in a low-mappability region of NSF in one previously unsolved proband, and the Chinese atypical Rolandic epilepsy exome cohort (PMID 34279234), which lists NSF as a recurrent candidate gene in a GABAergic-synapse pathway enrichment — both limited, non-definitive human evidence supporting "Existing". Supporting biological plausibility comes from non-human/in vitro work: antisense knockdown of NSF altering neurite outgrowth in rat hippocampal neurons and PC12 cells (PMID 11978405) and kindling-induced reductions in NSF with SNARE complex accumulation in rats (PMIDs 18513349, 22150629).
